analysis.title: GS Consumer: A Strong Morning. Resilient Spend.
key_insights: Retail earnings were solid this morning and pre-market moves were large: DKS +18%, ANF +12%, KSS +9% (also cited +7%), DLTR +8%, BBY +6%, BURL +6%.
4Q top-line guides are generally in-line, easing recent investor fears of a slow start to 4Q. With Black Friday ahead, the expected view is that spend will be solid around the event.
BURL +6% pre-market despite a +1% comp miss, as the bar was 0 to +1% and the 4Q comp guide is in-line. The stock was at recent lows on 3Q weather concerns, so GS sees potential relief.
BBY +6% after a +6.1% comp, the best in 5 years, with broad-based category strength. 4Q EPS guided above at the midpoint, but investors have not yet fully embraced the story.
DKS +18% on a beat vs consensus and somewhat negative positioning. The raise is smaller than the 3Q beat, but Foot Locker comps turned positive and Foot Locker US comps were +4%.
DLTR +8% on a comp beat slightly above expectations that was largely traffic driven. 4Q EPS and top-line guides are in-line, though a freight/margin debate remains for 2027.
KSS +7% after a comp beat of about 200 bps. The 4Q top-line guide midpoint is above consensus and implies a slightly positive comp, so trends have stabilized.
ANF +12% on a big beat versus an expected small beat. Comps were nearly equal at Abercrombie (+6%) and Hollister (+5%), so both banners are delivering at once for the first time in years.
GS cautions that market narratives can shift quickly, even on the day.
